titleZh: 欧委会指控 TikTok 未防止算法将用户引入有害内容 "兔子洞"
titleOriginal: Preliminary findings: the EU says TikTok violated the DSA by not preventing its recommendation algorithm from trapping users in harmful content "rabbit holes" (Alexander Martin/The Record)
summary: 欧委会指控 TikTok 违反 DSA，未防止推荐算法将用户引入有害内容 "兔子洞"。欧盟正在对 TikTok 进行监管审查。原文信息有限，建议阅读原文。
keyPoints: 欧委会指控 TikTok 违规
